app.name: Sentinel
app.tagline: Your AI email assistant. Nothing is sent without your confirmation.

failure.network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

auth.needs_reauth: This account needs to be reconnected.
auth.invalid_credentials: The username or password was not accepted.
auth.admin_consent_required: Your organisation requires an administrator to approve Sentinel before you can connect this account.
auth.consent_required: More permission is needed. Reconnect the account to grant it.

provider.resync: Your mailbox changed on the server, so Sentinel is syncing it again.
provider.unavailable: The mail provider is not available right now. Try again in a moment.
provider.generic: The mail provider returned an error.

ai.refusal: The AI declined to answer this one. Nothing was changed.
ai.truncated: The AI response was cut off. Try again.
ai.empty: The AI returned nothing. Try again.
ai.invalid: The AI response could not be used. Try again.

failure.ai_consent: Turn on AI processing for this account in AI settings first.

cap.cost: The monthly AI cost limit has been reached.
cap.tokens: The monthly AI token limit has been reached.

failure.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait {seconds} seconds.
failure.storage: Your data could not be saved. Try again.

validation.limit_reached: You have reached the maximum number of connected accounts.
validation.private_address: That server address is not allowed.
validation.tls_failed: A secure connection to the server could not be made. Check the security setting and port.
validation.unknown_folder: One of the selected folders does not exist.

failure.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.

send.expired: The confirmation expired. Review and confirm again.
send.content_changed: The message changed after you confirmed it. Review and confirm again.
send.placeholders: Replace the placeholders in the message first.
send.daily_limit: The daily sending limit has been reached.
